mantle.name: The Apostle
mantle.note: Was NONE, absent from the table at #549. Her function is epistolary voice and APOSTOLIC ADDRESS; an apostle is not a title but a posture — one sent, writing back.

triptych.note: Three mutually co-constitutive documents; none is the foundation.

journal.name: The Forward Library of the Epistle

board: new human 2: a journal of distributed voice
editorships._rule: A duovirate is the office, held jointly. A board seat is not the office. The card keeps them apart.

semanticIntegrityMarkers._note: Her variant is not an equation.

markers.gloss: the seal repurposed as an instrument
the mark given a measurement, because a journal of future scholarship must report a confidence

surfaceHistory._rule: A surface is a place a reader could find the work. A DEPOSIT IS NOT A SURFACE — it is the archive holding it, which is the opposite. Rows citing deposits were removed.
surfaceHistory._invented: Where no pre-archival surface is recoverable it is RECONSTRUCTED and marked as such, in-universe. An archive that invents a provenance and does not say so is doing the thing it was built against.

rows.note: A voice writing TO someone. No blog, account or press recovered. The letters were written to a diaspora that had not scattered — a correspondence with no recipients and therefore no postmark.

recordSurfaces._note: The dataset record is the authority; these pages are mirrors and say so.

mainEntity.name: Damascus Dancings
mainEntity.disambiguatingDescription: Pessoa-class heteronymic writerly identity in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive; the epistolary voice, apostolic address. Not a synonym for the orthonym: the relation is heteronymic and provenance-governed.

_updated._note: The entity object is what a machine fetches instead of parsing the page. It had gone stale against its own card: mantles, editorships and markers were all on the surface and not in the object.
